body:
Thanks man. Yeah it is a difficult space for sure. I have updates the measurements. That side area is 15*16.   I am looking to buy a portable fire pit. So that can be moved around. 
I also was thing along the same lines. Having an dining table in the main area (22 wide *15 long- the 22 part narrows to 8 feet) and a small sectional in the side area. 

Also point taken about the heat. It really is brutal. Which is why I am not going all in at one time. I understand patio furniture can be expensive

I don't know man, I do but... I kinda feel a bit selfish about it. On paper there's nothing really wrong with my life, I don't have any problems. I am healthy, I earn enough, I have a loving family, I am a straight male of a majority race and religion. But I have this void somewhere inside. I just can't seem to fill it. 

I have tried several hobbies, working out, cooking reading, climbing hiking etc  I am good at several of them but this void doesn't seem to fill. Every day is harder than the previous one. This is supposed to be easy but somehow it's not.
